summary: UI of docs/BIOME_TRAITS.md section 5 and the section 7.2 presentation of the kill rewards (HUD and results). (1) Menu: each biome card shows the icons of its active traits (TraitChipRow over the bottom edge of its preview: navy chips, light icons, saffron rim for the three kill rewards, at most 5 chips then '+N'). Under the cards, BiomeRulesView lists the selected biome's traits, one row per trait: icon, name, then a one-line description that takes the trait's parameters ('Étincelle plus rapide : × 2,1', '+30 % de vitesse sur ton terrain', 'Invincible 3 s après une élimination'). Rows sit on a soft navy panel. More than 5 traits (a custom matrix) switch to two columns of icon + name. The biome rules off or -classic show one line, 'Règles classiques : les mêmes règles partout'. The sets come from BiomeTraitTable.Resolve (traits-infra) and refresh on every SaveData.Changed and on a new selection. To make room, the color picker, JOUER, Options / Pays and the best line moved down (SwatchY 790 to 655, color label 900 to 765, JOUER 520 to 455, Options 330 to 270, best 190 to 145). The cards and the title (logo) did not move. (2) Options: a 'Règles des biomes' switch (SaveData.BiomeRulesOn) whose caption reads 'Chaque biome a ses règles' or 'Règles classiques'. In the hidden test settings, Réinitialiser is half width, next to a 'Traits des biomes' button. That button opens TraitMatrixPanel in place of the Options panel: one row per trait (all 11, TraitDefaults.All, icon + name) and three checkboxes L / F / E in each biome's signature color (teal, orange, yellow). A cell that differs from the default table wears a saffron rim. The panel has a note line ('S'applique à la prochaine manche et au menu', or a saffron 'Règles classiques actives : la matrice attend'), Réinitialiser (SaveData.ResetTraitMatrix) and Retour. A tick calls BiomeTraitTable.SetAssigned, so the next round uses it and GameDirector restarts the attract match at once (traits-infra). (3) HUD: toasts for the human's kill rewards: 'Tu as pris le terrain de Safran !', 'Vitesse +10 %' (the gain of that kill; 'Vitesse max : +30 %' at the cap) and 'Invincible 3 s' ('Invincible 3 s : étincelle éteinte !' when the shield put out the human's spark). A reward raised in the same frame as the kill toast of its victim merges into that toast. The land reward replaces 'Ton étincelle a eu Safran !'. The speed and shield rewards go on a second, saffron line of the same pill. So one kill never floods the 2-entry queue, and the shield toast is never 1.6 s late. A chased return after a quench reads 'Étincelle éteinte : boucle perdue.' (its Margin is 0) instead of 'Sauvé de justesse'. RewardChips, right of the pause button, gives the compact indicator. One chip shows the speed level ('+20 %', bolt icon, one pip per level up to the cap). The other shows the shield time (a ring that empties, '2,1 s', pulsing in the last second). The chips poll SimView (SpeedMultiplier, IsShielded, ShieldEndTime) on the sim render clock and fade in only while they mean something. (4) Results: the rank, area, cause and WHY lines did not change. When the human earned rewards, the stats block gains a second line ('1 terrain pris · vitesse +20 % · 1 bouclier', from Hud.Rewards). A saved return whose spark a shield put out gets the quenched line as its WHY. (5) Strings FR (accents, typographic apostrophe) and EN: trait.<Id>.name / trait.<Id>.desc for all 11 traits, two description variants (SparkSpeed below 1.8, KillInheritance share below 1), the options, matrix, menu, toast, chip and results keys. (6) TraitIcons draws 11 procedural icons plus a check mark from signed distances (96 px with mipmaps). Inertia is a U-turn arrow, Coalescence fusing drops, SparkSpeed a spark with speed lines, Propagation rings, ScorchedEarth a flame over a burnt line, Conduction a double chevron, ArcReach a jagged arc, RingInterval a clock ring, KillInheritance a flag, KillSpeedBoost a bolt and KillShield a shield. Dev aids for screenshots: -uidemo rewards (demo chips, toast and results line), -uidemo options,matrix. Evidence: quick Roslyn compile of Core + Runtime + EditMode, BuildWindows PASS with no shader error (Build/traits-ui). EditMode: 93 / 93 green (10 new tests plus UiStrings, WaveC_Ui, WaveC_Gate, WaveD_TraitsInfra, RuntimeSkeleton, WaveC_GameFlow, DemoScenario, Biome, S4Display). Classic probe [ProbeHash] 246577239DE179C4 at -fps 30 and -fps 144, with every texts@ check PASS. Fire probe with -traits default: 3DF3952B7C1BC26E (the traits-infra value), every texts@ check PASS. Both probes end FAIL only on the known 'PainterIO/EuropeMap has no _PIO_ShaderId' (europe package). Every screenshot was looked at: 3 biomes x 5 sizes of the menu, plus options, matrix and HUD / results at 5 sizes, English, and -classic.

contract_issues: BIOME_TRAITS 5 'each biome card shows its active traits as small icons with a one-line description': three cards side by side (290 units each) leave no room for 3 to 5 one-line descriptions per card. As built, every card shows its icons, and the selected biome's traits are listed with icon, name and description under the cards. Picking a card shows its rules. Suggested wording for section 27 / 15.2.

15.2 menu layout: the color picker and the elements below it moved down to make room for the rules list (SwatchY 655, ColorLabelY 765, PlayY 455, OptionsY 270, BestY 145; rules list centered at 900, 1000 x 200). CardsY, the cards, the title / logo and TitleYFor are unchanged (WaveC_UiTests / WaveC_GateTests hold).

15.2 Options: new row 'Règles des biomes' with a caption. In the hidden test settings, Réinitialiser is half width, next to 'Traits des biomes', which opens the matrix as a sub-panel (one row per trait, L / F / E, Réinitialiser, Retour, saffron rim on cells that differ from the table). Escape (UiRoot.HandleBack) still closes the whole Options panel.

15.3 HUD: reward chips right of the pause button (speed level with pips, shield ring with seconds). A toast may have a second line (ToastSubHeight 50): kill rewards of the same frame merge into the kill toast of their victim. 'Vitesse +10 %' is the gain of that kill, and the total at the cap ('Vitesse max : +30 %'). These are readings of BIOME_TRAITS 7.2.
15.3 / 15.5 saved line: a chased return after a KillShield quench (Margin 0) reads 'Étincelle éteinte : boucle perdue.' as a toast and as the results WHY line, not 'Sauvé de justesse'.

15.5 'ResultsScreen reads GameDirector.LastOutcome only': the reward line and the quenched WHY line also read Hud.Rewards (a UI-side tally of the human's TerritoryInherited / SpeedBoosted / ShieldStarted events). A HumanOutcome field would be cleaner (see needs).

15.6: new keys trait.<Id>.name / trait.<Id>.desc (11 ids), trait.SparkSpeed.desc_slow, trait.KillInheritance.desc_share, options.biome_rules / biome_rules_on / classic_rules / trait_matrix / matrix_note / matrix_classic / back / col_liquid / col_fire / col_electric, menu.rules_classic / rules_none / rules_more, toast.inherit / speed / speed_max / shield / shield_quench / quenched_return, hud.speed / hud.seconds, results.stat.inherit.one|other / speed / shields.one|other.
open_issues: During this package, other packages' work in progress blocked Unity runs for a while. LiquidComposite.hlsl called PIO_ValueNoise before its definition, and ElectricOverlay.hlsl had syntax errors, so the first two builds of Build/traits-ui logged shader errors. SeveredTerritoryTests.cs had CS0051, which stopped one EditMode run. Both were fixed by their owners, and the final build and test run are clean.

docs/waveA, docs/waveB, docs/waveD and parts of docs/waveC / docs/europe shots disappeared from the working tree around 01:18 and came back around 01:22 (git shows no deletion now). The cause is unknown (not this package).
Landscape (1280 x 720, UI at 0.375 per 26.4): the rules list text is about 10 px high, like the rest of the menu at that scale. Acceptable for the Windows dev mode only.

The DemoScenario story has no kill by the human, so the real reward toasts and chips were checked by EditMode tests (synthetic events on a real session) and in screenshots through -uidemo rewards. They were not seen in a live round in a build. The infra 'trait_reward' probe shot shows a bot's reward, so no human toast appears there (as intended).
With all 11 traits on one biome, the card shows 4 icons and '+7', and the rules list switches to two columns of names without descriptions (checked in EditMode, not in a screenshot).
